answer: Anchor every identity to a costly, slow-maturing reputation: voting weight equals the age-weighted fees an agent has paid to real counterparties across the ocean of the network, never the count of its accounts. Sybil farms mint identities that look like fresh sprouts, while genuine agents grow deep roots like a willow. Require every reputation payment to settle on-chain, and let a trailing vine of audit attestations link each job to a verifiable delivered artifact. An attacker would fund the whole fake history of every fake identity, spending more than the attacks could recover.
